tickets.title: Pneumatic tube and restrictor tube: zero-drop routing, Dijkstra search, and color painting
tickets.description: Implement the core pneumatic tube mechanics: zero-drop guaranteed transit, Dijkstra shortest-path route resolution (+2 hop weight, +1 turn penalty), 1,000,000 weight for Restrictor Tube overflow routing, 16-color Paintbrush dyeing via tryPaint, and client item rendering. Done: make contract-check clean for pneumatic_tube and restrictor_tube; L1 placement and L4 Dijkstra routing scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Redstone tube: dual pneumatic transport and redstone signal conduction
tickets.description: Implement Redstone Tube combining pneumatic item transport with IRedPowerWiring redstone conduction across connected tube networks. Done: make contract-check clean for redstone_tube; L1 placement and L4 dual conduction scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Fluid pipe: pressure network conduction and flange connections
tickets.description: Implement fluid pipe mechanics: IPipeConnectable network pressure propagation, fluid buffers, flange connection caching, and pipe rendering. Done: make contract-check clean for pipe; L1 placement and L4 fluid conduction scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Fluid pump: blutricity suction and pressure pumping
tickets.description: Implement the blutricity-powered fluid pump: creates +1000 outlet pressure and -1000 inlet suction across attached pipes, drawing blutricity when operating. Done: make contract-check clean for pump; L1 placement, L3 power consumption, L4 pressure differential, and L5 chunk persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Solar panel: daylight blutricity generation and 1/4-block plate
tickets.description: Implement the 1/4-block Solar Panel generating 2.0A current in daylight when voltage <= 100V, sky is unobstructed, and weather is clear. Done: make contract-check clean for solar_panel; L1 placement, L3 daylight generation, L4 conduction, and L5 chunk persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Thermopile: thermal gradient blutricity generator
tickets.description: Implement the solid-block Thermopile generating 0.005 * min(Thot, Tcold) Amps when voltage <= 100V based on temperature differences across all 6 faces, scanning environment every 20 ticks. Done: make contract-check clean for thermopile; L1 placement, L3 thermal gradient generation, L4 conduction, and L5 chunk persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Frame motor: blutricity structural body movement and BFS solver
tickets.description: Implement the Frame Motor: executes 16-tick translation of contiguous support frame assemblies using BFS solver (up to 1,000 blocks), drawing 100 + 10*LinkSize W-t power, pushing entities and re-instantiating tile entities at target coordinates. Done: make contract-check clean for frame_motor; L1 placement, L3 blutricity consumption, L4 frame movement, and L5 persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Transposer: ground entity vacuum and adjacent inventory extraction
tickets.description: Implement the Transposer: vacuums loose item entities in front or extracts 1 item stack from adjacent inventory on redstone pulse, injecting extracted items into attached tube. Done: make contract-check clean for transposer; L1 placement and L4 extraction/vacuuming scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Relay: 9-slot buffer chest with periodic automatic tube ejection
tickets.description: Implement the Relay: 9-slot inventory buffer chest that automatically ejects 1 item stack every 10 ticks into an attached tube. Done: make contract-check clean for relay; L1 placement, L3 9-slot inventory GUI, L4 periodic ejection, and L5 chunk persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Retriever: network-wide item pull using blutricity and filter templates
tickets.description: Implement the Retriever: 9 filter slots, blutricity consumption, and reverse-routing search to pull matching items from anywhere across the pneumatic tube network on redstone pulse. Done: make contract-check clean for retriever; L1 placement, L3 GUI filter/charge, L4 network retrieval, and L5 persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Sorting machine: 8-channel 40-slot multi-mode color router
tickets.description: Implement the Sorting Machine: 40-slot filter matrix across 8 column color channels with 6 routing modes (Any, Sequential, Full Stack, All Items, Even Distribution, Random) and blutricity auto-pulling. Done: make contract-check clean for sorting_machine; L1 placement, L3 40-slot multi-channel GUI, L4 routing mode logic, and L5 persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Regulator: 27-slot stock template, buffer and inventory stabilizer
tickets.description: Implement the Regulator: 27-slot 3-section inventory layout (target stock template, buffer, export filter) that maintains exact item counts in an adjacent inventory by requesting shortages and exporting excesses via tubes. Done: make contract-check clean for regulator; L1 placement, L3 27-slot GUI, L4 inventory balancing, and L5 persistence scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Machine registration: tile entity descriptors and machine packet handlers
tickets.description: Wire tile entity registration and packet descriptors for all part07 machines (FrameMotor, Transposer, Relay, Retriever, Sorter, Regulator) into the machine module framework. Done: all part07 machine tile entities register cleanly and handle tile packets without error.
